title: ds-alzheimers-biomarkers-nulisa: analysis code for "Integrated lifespan analysis of blood-based biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease and neuropathology in Down syndrome"
description: R-based statistical analysis and visualization code supporting the manuscript "Integrated lifespan analysis of blood-based biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease and neuropathology in Down syndrome". The repository contains self-contained R Projects that analyze plasma proteomics generated with the NULISA CNS120 panel in the Human Trisome Project (HTP) and WUSTL cohorts, including comparisons by karyotype (trisomy 21 vs. euploid controls), age, sex, BMI and APOE4 carrier status, sliding-window, age-trajectory clustering, biomarker-ratio, correlation and longitudinal analyses, and APOE genotyping from whole-genome sequencing.
